scan.title: New Scan
scan.auto_detect_hint: Just upload photo — AI detects crop and plant health!
scan.rescue_title: 🚨 Immediate Action to Save Your Crop
scan.rescue_subtitle: Safe, practical steps to protect the plant right now
scan.upload_hint: Tap to upload. Max 8 MB. Supports JPEG, PNG.
scan.severity_note: Based on this photo only, not a diagnosis.
scan.top3_low_confidence_note: Low confidence, results are possibilities only
scan.low_confidence_banner: Diagnostic confidence is low. For optimal precision, retake the photo in balanced daylight or seek additional field verification.
scan.uncertain_message: The AI could not tell clearly. Take a new photo of one leaf, close up, in daylight.
scan.expert_help_banner: In severe crop stress, complementary field inspection by local agronomic specialists is recommended.
scan.error_invalid_file: Please upload a valid image file (JPEG or PNG).
scan.error_too_dark: Photo is too dark. Retake in better lighting.
scan.error_too_bright: Photo is overexposed. Avoid direct sunlight.
scan.error_too_blurry: Photo is too blurry. Hold steady and retake.
scan.error_file_too_large: Image exceeds 8 MB limit. Please compress or retake.
scan.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
scan.not_sure: Not sure — please retake the photo
scan.expert_banner_soft: This result may be wrong. Show the leaf to your local agriculture officer or KVK.
scan.general_action: Keep the field clean, avoid wetting leaves, and monitor nearby plants.
scan.consult_kvk: Agronomic screening advisory for field decision-support. Local agrarian extension practices and regional field officers may be referred to for personalized guidance.
scan.footer_disclaimer: AgriGuard is an AI screening tool for crops, plants and vegetables. It can be wrong and does not replace your agriculture officer or KVK.
scan.screen_only_note: AgriGuard’s disease model does not cover this crop yet, so it only checked the leaf for spots and yellowing. This is not a diagnosis — if the plant looks unwell, ask your local agriculture officer or KVK.
scan.early_signs_note: Only a small part of the leaf is affected. Acting now — removing affected leaves and checking nearby plants — can stop it spreading.
scan.retake_body: The AI did not check this photo, so no diagnosis is given. A wrong photo can give a wrong result.
scan.retake_hand: A hand or person is visible. Only the crop should be in the photo.
scan.retake_objects: Gloves, paper or foreign objects are visible. Remove them from the photo.
scan.retake_no_leaf: Crop not detected or did not cover the photo. Take a close photo covering the crop.
scan.retake_too_dark: The photo is too dark. Take it in clear daylight.
scan.retake_too_bright: The photo is too bright / overexposed. Avoid harsh glare.
scan.retake_tip: Tip: Take a close photo so the crop fills the frame, against the plant or ground, in daylight. No hands, gloves, paper or foreign tools.

landing.headline: Check your crop & plant leaves in seconds
landing.sub: Take a photo of a leaf and get AI-assisted screening, a visible-damage estimate and simple care guidance. Built for Indian farmers.
landing.step1_b: Choose the crop, or let AgriGuard detect it from the photo.
landing.step2_b: One leaf, good light, fill the frame. We check quality before analysing.
landing.step3_b: See the possible problem, confidence, visible damage and general care steps.
landing.resp1: Low-confidence results say “not sure” instead of guessing.
landing.resp2: General care guidance only, no product or dose prescriptions.
landing.resp3: Notes when regional field officers and local extension practices may be helpful to refer to.
landing.road_note: These are planned, not available yet.
landing.road2: Field sensor readings next to leaf scans
landing.n2: possible answers: healthy, possible problem, or not sure

lp.h1: A second look at every leaf.
lp.sub: Photograph a leaf from any crop, plant or vegetable. AgriGuard screens it for possible disease, estimates the visible damage and outlines sensible next steps for your field.
lp.s1p: Good light, leaf filling the frame. AgriGuard checks the photo quality first and asks for a retake if it is too dark or blurry.
lp.s2p: The model compares the leaf with known disease patterns and measures how much of the leaf shows damage.
lp.s3p: A possible problem, how sure the AI is, visible damage, and general care steps. If it is not sure, it says so.
lp.hon_h: Built to be honest about what it knows.
lp.hon_p: AgriGuard is a screening aid, not a doctor. These are the commitments in how it is built.
lp.n2: possible answers: healthy, possible problem, or “not sure”
lp.c1p: Possible disease for field crops, horticultural plants and vegetables, with a confidence level and the next most likely options.
lp.c2p: An AI estimate of how much of the leaf shows damage, labelled as an estimate every time.
lp.c3p: General sanitation and care steps, with notes on when local extension practices may be worth referring to.
lp.c4p: Every scan is saved so you can see whether a leaf is getting better or worse.
lp.c5p: Soil moisture, temperature and humidity shown beside your leaf scans.
lp.a1: No. It is AI-assisted screening and a first look. Agronomic screening advisory for field decision-support. Local agrarian extension practices and regional field officers may be referred to for personalized guidance.
lp.a2: When the AI is not confident enough, it does not guess a disease. It suggests a retake in better light, and regional extension guidance may be referred to for persistent symptoms.
lp.q3: Will it tell me what to spray?
lp.a3: No. It offers general care steps only. Treatment choices and doses are best aligned with local agrarian extension practices and regional field officers.
lp.a4: English and Tamil, with voice read-out of the result. More languages are planned.
lp.badge: Live AI screening · Crops, Plants & Vegetables
lp.spec_p: Field crops, horticultural plants and vegetables. Tap a specimen to preview a sample screening result.
lp.f1p: Tracks airborne spore drift across neighbouring farms using wind vectors and live microclimate data, so a cluster can act before lesions appear.
lp.f2p: Weighs pre-harvest intervals, residue limits and mandi prices to compare treat-now against harvest-clean scenarios in rupees.
lp.f3p: Every screen and voice read-out in English and Tamil, switchable in one tap.
lp.f4p: Soil moisture, temperature, humidity and a DSV disease-risk index beside your scans.

home.h1: Upload a leaf photo, know your crop's health in seconds
home.sub: Take a clear photo of one leaf. AgriGuard checks it for common diseases and tells you what to do next, in English or Tamil.
home.screening_note: AI-assisted screening, not a final diagnosis.
home.step1_p: Photograph one leaf in daylight. It works on slow internet: the photo is made smaller before it is sent.
home.step2_p: The AI compares your leaf with thousands of examples and shows the likely disease and how sure it is.
home.step3_p: Get simple steps to protect your crop. If the AI is not sure, it tells you to visit your agriculture officer or KVK.
home.f1_p: Screens leaf photos for common diseases across 14 crops, with a confidence level on every result.
home.f2_p: Field sensors send an alert to the land owner's phone when conditions turn risky. No app is needed to receive it.
home.f3_p: ESP32 sensors track soil moisture, temperature and humidity, so you can spot disease-friendly weather early.
home.end_h: Worried about a leaf? Check it now.
home.foot_tagline: AI crop health screening for Indian farmers.
home.fact_alerts: field alerts to the land owner

upload.title: Check a leaf
upload.intro: Take one clear photo of a leaf. We will show you what the AI sees.
upload.photo_hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 8 MB. The photo is made smaller before sending, so it works on slow internet.
upload.auto_hint: Recommended. The AI works out the crop from the photo.
upload.tip1: Daylight, with no flash or harsh shadow
upload.tip2: One leaf, close up, filling the frame
upload.tip3: No hands, gloves or paper in the photo
upload.loading_slow: Slow connection, still working. Please keep this page open.
